method_proposal.differentiation: There is no previously bound Method Lineage in context.bound_methods, so no in-campaign nearest lineage exists. The closest catalogue family is conventional latent-space Bayesian optimization; unlike that family, this lineage never fits the objective GP to latent codes or optimizes an acquisition function over a bounded latent box. It fits the surrogate in molecular structure space and proposes molecules de novo by sampling a VAE prior after a Bayesian posterior tilt, which is a distinct proposal mechanism rather than a kernel or acquisition-constant variation.
method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the root succeeds, keep the VAE and posterior-tilted pCN proposal loop fixed and replace the single-fingerprint surrogate with online likelihood-weighted selection among Tanimoto GPs built on complementary molecular fingerprints. MolLIBRA's PMO-300 ablation indicates that the useful fingerprint is task-dependent and that multi-fingerprint critics can help at a 300-call budget; adapting only this surrogate mechanism should reduce representation-specific blind spots and increase the chance that each ten-molecule batch contains a higher terminal Top-1 candidate.

method_proposal.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic SELFIES variational autoencoder on the unlabeled corpus solely as a de novo molecular generator, while fitting the online objective surrogate only on oracle-evaluated molecules using count-based molecular fingerprints and a Tanimoto Gaussian process. At each feedback round, use preconditioned Crank-Nicolson sampling to draw new latent points from the VAE prior tilted by the GP posterior probability of exceeding the incumbent, decode them into previously unseen molecules, and greedily choose a high-utility batch of ten. Decoupling generation from structure-space prediction avoids requiring objective smoothness in the VAE latent geometry and directs the fixed 290 post-initial oracle calls toward molecules likely to improve the final Top-1 rather than screening or retrieving a finite corpus pool.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is COWBOYS decoupled structure-space Bayesian generation because both begin with an unlabeled-data-trained neural molecular generator. COWBOYS keeps its VAE fixed, learns a fingerprint Gaussian process, and proposes by pCN sampling from a posterior-tilted latent prior; this lineage instead directly updates an autoregressive policy from oracle rewards and proposes by token-level ancestral sampling, with no surrogate, acquisition function, or latent MCMC. It also differs from the bound de novo molecular graph genetic algorithm: it generates whole SMILES through learned sequence probabilities rather than recombining and mutating evaluated parent graphs. The supplied mechanism-cluster history is empty, so no campaign evidence refutes this policy-optimization family.
method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the root succeeds, add one bounded reward-prioritized experience-replay mechanism while keeping the generator and Augmented Hill-Climb loss fixed: retain the best unique evaluated molecules from earlier batches and include their scored trajectories alongside the current top fraction in later policy updates. This reuses costly oracle information without extra calls or cross-task state; Guo and Schwaller report that experience replay improves AHC and other policy algorithms. Final Top-1 remains the success criterion, while replay frequency and increased agent likelihood on buffered elites serve only as activation evidence.

method_proposal.method_thesis: Pretrain an autoregressive SMILES language model on the allowed unlabeled corpus and freeze a copy as the molecular prior. During each objective session, sample complete molecules de novo token by token from a trainable agent, rank the accepted molecules by their observed oracle rewards, and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction using the Augmented Hill-Climb loss: the squared gap between agent log-likelihood and a target formed from prior log-likelihood plus scaled reward. Excluding low-reward samples from policy updates prevents them from repeatedly pulling the agent back toward the prior, while prior likelihood still regularizes the elite updates; this concentrates the scarce feedback on sequences associated with improvement of final Top-1 without screening a finite molecular pool.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization because both begin with an unlabeled-corpus-trained sequence model. Augmented Hill-Climb changes the model weights using top-fraction oracle rewards and proposes by direct ancestral sampling from that changing policy; this lineage freezes the sequence model and lets oracle feedback change only explicit prefix-tree visit and value statistics, with proposals produced by UCT selection, expansion, rollout, and backpropagation. It also differs from the bound graph genetic algorithm because it constructs molecules token by token from an empty root rather than crossing and mutating evaluated parent graphs, and from COWBOYS because it has no VAE latent search, fingerprint GP, posterior tilt, or pCN sampling. The supplied mechanism-cluster history is empty, so no prior campaign cluster refutes this tree-search family.
method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the root succeeds, keep the frozen recurrent prior and all expansion and rollout logic fixed, but replace mean-only UCT exploitation with one best-return-sensitive backup that mixes each prefix's maximum and average observed downstream reward. ChemTSv3 exposes this best-rate mechanism and recommends a nonzero best/mean mixture for more sample-efficient de novo search. Because this benchmark ranks final Top-1, preserving the influence of a rare exceptional completion should revisit prefixes capable of producing a stronger terminal molecule instead of letting that signal be diluted by mediocre sibling rollouts.

method_proposal.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic recurrent next-token model on the allowed unlabeled SMILES corpus and freeze it as a chemical-language prior. For each independent objective session, grow a fresh Monte Carlo search tree whose nodes are SMILES prefixes: initialize available path statistics from the ten scored starting molecules, select prefixes by an upper-confidence tree rule, expand them with high-probability unseen tokens from the frozen model, and use model rollouts to complete new molecules. Canonicalize locally and submit batches containing only newly constructed, valid, unique terminal SMILES; after each oracle response, backpropagate the observed scores through the visited prefix paths. The dynamically expanded tree therefore converts 290 feedback calls into increasingly focused de novo construction toward high terminal rewards without updating a policy, fitting a latent surrogate, mutating evaluated parent graphs, or ranking a finite corpus pool.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is the de novo molecular graph genetic algorithm because both exploit fragments from evaluated molecules and feed successful offspring back into later proposals. The graph GA proposes by hard-coded stochastic graph crossover and atom, bond, ring, or fragment mutation of selected parent graphs; this lineage instead attaches reward-ranked fragment contexts and samples a replacement fragment from a learned conditional distribution through repeated whole-span masking and bidirectional discrete-diffusion denoising. That proposal mechanism can create a fragment absent from the current vocabulary and uses neither graph crossover nor the GA mutation portfolio. Unlike Augmented Hill-Climb, its frozen denoiser receives no reward-gradient update and generation is non-autoregressive; unlike ChemTS, it has no prefix tree or UCT rollout; unlike COWBOYS, it has no continuous latent search, GP acquisition, or pCN sampler. The supplied mechanism-cluster history is empty, so no campaign cluster has refuted discrete-diffusion fragment remasking.
method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the unguided root succeeds, add only GenMol's molecular context guidance to the reverse-denoising logits while keeping the trained denoiser, fragment scoring, attachment, and remasking loop fixed: contrast the prediction from the intact retained-fragment context with a deliberately weakened-context prediction and extrapolate toward the intact-context result at one task-agnostic guidance strength. GenMol's published goal-directed ablation improves its 23-task PMO sum from 18.208 for attachment plus fragment remasking to 18.362 with this guidance and reports the guided version best on 19 of 23 tasks. Although that evidence uses PMO AUC Top-10 rather than this campaign's terminal Top-1, it supports the causal direction that stronger use of high-reward retained context can make each de novo replacement more productive; the campaign score remains the decision criterion.

method_tags.proposal_mechanism: score-biased fragment attachment followed by whole-fragment masking and iterative bidirectional discrete-diffusion denoising

method_proposal.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic bidirectional masked discrete-diffusion model on SAFE fragment sequences from the allowed unlabeled corpus, then keep its weights frozen during every objective session. Initialize a dynamic fragment vocabulary only from oracle-evaluated molecules, score each fragment by the observed rewards of molecules containing it, and construct each new starting context by sampling and attaching high-scoring fragments. Replace one complete fragment span with mask tokens and iteratively denoise that span in parallel while conditioning on the retained fragments; canonicalize locally and submit only newly generated valid unique molecules. Oracle feedback updates fragment scores and admits fragments from evaluated offspring, so the generator can repeatedly refine promising chemistry while its learned conditional denoising can synthesize fragments outside the current vocabulary. Every candidate is therefore generated de novo rather than retrieved or ranked from the corpus, and reward-directed fragment regeneration targets improvement of the final Top-1 within the sparse feedback budget.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is the de novo molecular graph genetic algorithm because both construct offspring by editing evaluated molecular graphs. The graph GA globally applies rank-biased parent selection, two-parent crossover, mutation, and elitist population replacement; this lineage instead preserves ten chain identities, proposes a single reversible add/delete transition from each current state, and applies a local Metropolis-Hastings decision that can deliberately retain a worse-scoring move early in the annealing schedule. It has no crossover, reproductive ranking, or elitist replacement. It also differs from COWBOYS by using neither a VAE, structure GP, acquisition batch selection, nor latent pCN; from Augmented Hill-Climb by using no autoregressive policy or reward-gradient update; from ChemTS by using no prefix tree, UCT selection, or rollout; and from GenMol by using no learned denoiser or fragment remasking. The supplied mechanism-cluster history is empty, so no campaign cluster has refuted annealed molecular MCMC.
method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the root succeeds, change only the edit proposal from uniform reversible choices to a MARS-style adaptive proposal: fit a lightweight graph editor by maximum likelihood on previously observed transitions whose candidate beat its chain state, while mixing every learned distribution with the uniform kernel so reverse support and the Metropolis-Hastings correction remain defined. Xie et al.'s controlled ablation found annealed sampling with the adaptive proposal better than annealed sampling with random edits in both reported settings and states that it converged 4.6 times faster. Although those experiments used multi-property success metrics and a larger run rather than this campaign's terminal Top-1 at 300 calls, they support the causal direction that concentrating proposals on empirically productive attachment sites and fragments can spend more of the 290 adaptive calls near improving transitions; final Top-1 remains the campaign decision criterion.

method_tags.learning_mechanism: training-free root in which oracle feedback updates chain states and annealed target concentration rather than model parameters

method_proposal.method_thesis: Extract a vocabulary of single-attachment fragments from the allowed unlabeled corpus without scoring or retrieving any whole corpus molecule, and start one persistent molecular-graph Markov chain from each of the ten fixed evaluated molecules. In every feedback round, generate one fresh candidate per chain through a locally sanitized, reversible fragment-add or fragment-delete transition, retrying locally until the batch contains ten novel canonical molecules. After the oracle returns, accept each proposed state with a Metropolis-Hastings probability for an annealed score density, including its forward/reverse proposal ratio; rejected proposals leave their chains at the previous states. Low inverse temperature initially permits controlled downhill moves that can cross structural valleys, while increasing concentration later favors high-score states. Thus all oracle calls evaluate de novo molecular constructions, and feedback directly steers persistent search paths toward a stronger final Top-1 without a surrogate, a learned generator, or finite-library screening.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization because both adapt a pretrained generator with oracle feedback. Augmented Hill-Climb retains only the top fraction of sampled SMILES and regresses agent log-likelihood toward a prior-plus-reward target along each molecule's single left-to-right tokenization; this lineage instead samples graph constructions from an empty state and enforces trajectory balance between learned forward and backward policies, a partition function, and terminal reward across the multiple action orders that can reach the same graph. It is therefore a flow-consistency sampler rather than expected-reward hill climbing. The root also differs from the graph genetic algorithm because it uses neither parent crossover nor stochastic mutation; from COWBOYS because it fits no fingerprint GP, VAE posterior tilt, or latent pCN chain; from ChemTS because it maintains no explicit prefix tree, UCT values, or rollouts; from GenMol because it performs forward graph construction rather than fragment masking and reverse diffusion; and from annealed fragment-edit sampling because it has no persistent molecular chains or Metropolis-Hastings accept/reject step. The supplied mechanism-cluster history is empty, so no campaign cluster refutes this GFlowNet family.
method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the root succeeds, add exactly one Genetic-GFN-style guided-exploration mechanism while freezing the graph grammar, trajectory-balance objective, reward transform, and replay rule: apply a bounded graph-genetic refinement loop to current forward-policy samples, oracle-evaluate only the resulting novel de novo offspring, and feed their scored trajectories into the same off-policy replay buffer. Kim et al.'s PMO ablation reports AUC Top-1 of 16.530 with genetic search versus 16.070 without it, and its generation-count ablation reports 16.527 for two refinement generations versus 16.070 for none. Those experiments use a much larger PMO run and an AUC metric rather than this campaign's 300-call terminal Top-1, so they establish only the causal direction that genetic refinement can supply more productive off-policy trajectories; promotion here must still be decided by the frozen five-task final Top-1 mean.

method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline unlabeled construction-policy pretraining followed by online off-policy trajectory-balance updates on reward-prioritized evaluated trajectories

method_proposal.method_thesis: Learn a task-agnostic forward and backward molecular-construction policy from the allowed unlabeled corpus using an atom-and-fragment graph grammar, then restart that policy independently for each objective. From an empty graph, the forward policy samples chemically valid attachment, bond, and stop actions until it produces a terminal molecule; whole corpus molecules are never retrieved, ranked, or used as a finite candidate pool. After each evaluator-announced batch is scored, map each observed score to a strictly positive tempered terminal reward and train on only oracle-evaluated molecules and their sampled construction/deconstruction trajectories using the trajectory-balance loss, a learned partition function, and reward-prioritized replay. Because trajectory balance assigns terminal probability according to total flow across every construction route rather than merely increasing the likelihood of one elite sequence, online feedback amortizes search into a de novo sampler whose probability mass concentrates on high-reward molecular regions while continuing to expose distinct routes to rare high-scoring structures. The optimization target remains the mean final Top-1 across the five independent sessions; flow statistics and replay usage are mechanism evidence, not substitute objectives.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is COWBOYS decoupled structure-space Bayesian generation because both combine an unlabeled-corpus neural generator with online Bayesian optimization. COWBOYS leaves objective prediction in fingerprint structure space and proposes by preconditioned Crank-Nicolson sampling from a VAE prior tilted by posterior probability of improvement, followed by expected-improvement selection. This lineage instead attaches every observed score to an exactly reconstructible SeqFlow latent code and proposes through evaluated-anchor trust-region coordinate perturbations and latent-posterior Thompson selection. Moving the surrogate into the invertible sequence latent space and replacing posterior-tilted prior MCMC with local latent perturbation is a different proposal mechanism, not a kernel or acquisition-constant variation. It also uses no graph crossover or mutation, reward-likelihood policy update, UCT prefix tree, fragment-remasking diffusion, persistent Metropolis-Hastings chain, or trajectory-balance construction policy; despite its name, a normalizing flow is an invertible density map rather than the reward-proportional GFlowNet already bound. The supplied mechanism-cluster history is empty, so no campaign cluster refutes this family.
method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the uniform-perturbation root succeeds, change only how latent token blocks are chosen for perturbation: add NF-BO's Token-level Adaptive Candidate Sampling, weighting each block by its SeqFlow pointwise-mutual-information importance for the current anchor while keeping the flow, surrogate, trust regions, and Thompson acquisition fixed. Lee et al.'s controlled GuacaMol ablation reports better optimization performance with TACS than with uniform coordinate sampling, alongside a more distinct candidate pool. That evidence comes from a larger evaluation setting than this campaign, so distinctness is only activation evidence here; the testable reason to import TACS is that a more productive de novo acquisition pool may improve the five-task terminal Top-1 mean within the 300-call budget.

method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline corpus-only SeqFlow training plus a task-local latent Gaussian process fit only to oracle-evaluated molecule-score pairs

method_proposal.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive normalizing flow on corpus-only SELFIES so that each discrete molecule has a continuous token-latent encoding whose left-inverse reconstructs that same sequence. In each fresh objective session, encode the oracle-evaluated molecules, fit a task-local Gaussian-process surrogate to their latent codes and observed scores, and center local trust regions on high-scoring evaluated anchors. Generate a new ephemeral candidate pool each round by uniformly choosing latent-token blocks to perturb inside those regions, inverse-decode the perturbed points, and locally reject invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate molecules before using posterior Thompson samples to choose the announced batch. Returned scores update the surrogate, anchors, and trust-region state. The corpus supplies only representation learning: no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or treated as a fixed candidate, and every oracle proposal is a newly decoded de novo molecule selected to raise terminal Top-1.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is SeqFlow-invertible trust-region latent Bayesian optimization because both generate molecules by decoding continuous latent points. SeqFlow fits a latent Gaussian process, centers trust regions on evaluated anchors, and Thompson-selects from an ephemeral pool of perturbed codes; this lineage fits no surrogate and performs no surrogate pre-ranking of an overgenerated pool, but uses CMA-ES feedback ranks to update one persistent Gaussian search distribution and draws the next de novo molecules directly from it. Compared with COWBOYS decoupled structure-space Bayesian generation, it has no fingerprint GP, posterior-probability tilt, preconditioned Crank-Nicolson chain, or expected-improvement selector. Compared with the graph GA and annealed fragment-edit MCMC lineages, it uses neither graph crossover and mutation nor persistent graph chains with Metropolis-Hastings decisions. Compared with Augmented Hill-Climb, the molecular decoder remains frozen and feedback updates a latent search distribution rather than token likelihoods. Compared with ChemTS it has no prefix tree or UCT; compared with GenMol it has no SAFE fragment remasking or reverse diffusion; and compared with the molecular GFlowNet it has no graph-action flow or trajectory-balance loss. It is therefore a different optimization paradigm and proposal mechanism, not an encoder, kernel, or acquisition-constant variation within latent Bayesian optimization. The supplied mechanism-cluster history is empty, so no campaign cluster refutes latent covariance evolution.
method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the root succeeds, keep the dense autoencoder, rank weights, de novo decoding, and standard CMA-ES step-size rule fixed, and add only CMA-ES-LED's signal-to-noise effective-dimension adaptation: estimate active directions in the current covariance eigenbasis from the mean and rank-mu updates, then compute the covariance learning rates from the estimated rather than nominal latent dimension. Uchida, Yamaguchi, and Shirakawa report that CMA-ES-LED outperforms standard CMA-ES on rotated low-effective-dimensionality benchmark functions. That evidence is cross-domain rather than a 300-call molecular result, so the transfer claim is conditional: if task reward varies along only a few coordinated molecular-latent directions, faster covariance learning across the limited feedback rounds should increase the chance of a stronger terminal Top-1; the estimated effective dimension is activation evidence, not a substitute objective.

method_tags.proposal_mechanism: CMA-ES ask/tell sampling from a rank-adapted multivariate Gaussian followed by de novo SMILES decoding

method_proposal.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic MolMIM-style probabilistic SMILES autoencoder only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, using variance-conditioned latent training so local perturbations remain decodable, and then freeze it. In each independent objective session, encode the fixed evaluated starting molecules, center a CMA-ES search distribution on the best observed latent, and repeat an ask/tell loop: sample a fresh latent population from the current multivariate Gaussian, decode each point de novo, canonicalize and locally replace invalid or previously seen molecules, submit only the newly decoded batch, and update the Gaussian mean, covariance, and global step size from the returned score ranks. The method neither fits a surrogate nor screens the corpus; oracle feedback changes the continuous proposal distribution directly, so coordinated latent directions that repeatedly yield better molecules receive more probability during the 290 adaptive calls. The sole success target is the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is MolMIM latent covariance-matrix evolution because both freeze a corpus-trained continuous molecular generator and use surrogate-free feedback in its latent space. MolMIM's CMA-ES forgets individual trajectories and asks from one rank-adapted multivariate Gaussian whose mean, covariance, and step size are population parameters; this lineage preserves particle identity, velocity, and personal-best memory and asks by moving each particle toward explicit personal and social exemplars, with no learned covariance distribution or rank-weighted Gaussian sampling. It differs from the bound SeqFlow and COWBOYS lineages by fitting no GP and using no trust region, Thompson acquisition, posterior tilt, or latent MCMC; from Augmented Hill-Climb and the molecular GFlowNet by applying no reward update to generator weights and no trajectory-balance loss; from the graph GA and annealed fragment-edit sampler by using neither graph crossover/mutation nor Metropolis-Hastings transitions; from ChemTS by maintaining no prefix tree; and from GenMol by performing no fragment remasking or reverse diffusion. The supplied mechanism-cluster map is empty, so no campaign cluster has refuted latent particle-swarm search.
method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the root succeeds, change only its social communication topology: replace attraction to the all-swarm best and historical all-swarm best with attraction to the best personal-best position in each particle's fixed ring neighborhood, while keeping the autoencoder, persistent velocities, cognitive term, and direct decoding loop fixed. Ghosh et al. identify global-best PSO as susceptible to premature convergence on multimodal landscapes and analyze the greater explorative power of local-best communication. If the molecular latent swarm is collapsing onto one decoded basin, slower propagation of an early winner should preserve independent searches long enough to increase the chance of a stronger final Top-1 within the remaining feedback rounds; latent swarm spread and distinct decoded chemotypes would be activation evidence only, not substitute objectives.

method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline unlabeled molecular-autoencoder training plus online oracle-driven updates of particle and swarm best memories
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: persistent latent-particle velocity updates toward personal, current swarm, and historical swarm bests followed by de novo SMILES decoding
method_tags.representation: continuous molecular codes from a corpus-trained randomized-to-canonical SMILES translation autoencoder

method_proposal.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic sequence-to-sequence molecular autoencoder on randomized and canonicalized SMILES views of the allowed unlabeled corpus, then freeze its encoder and decoder. At the start of each independent objective session, encode the ten fixed scored initial molecules as ten persistent particles with latent velocities and personal-best memories. After every oracle response, update the personal and swarm-best memories, move each particle by the Molecular Swarm Optimization rule combining inertia with stochastic attraction toward its own best and the swarm's current and historical best positions, and decode one fresh valid unique molecule from each resulting trajectory for the next announced batch. Oracle scores therefore steer interacting de novo latent trajectories directly, without fitting a surrogate or selecting from the corpus, and the 290 adaptive calls are concentrated on finding an exceptional terminal molecule for final Top-1.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is De novo molecular graph genetic algorithm because both use sanitized crossover and mutation on evaluated molecular graphs. This lineage instead makes a fixed descriptor tessellation the persistent search state, samples cell elites without global score ranking, and lets an offspring compete only with the incumbent in its own cell. The resulting niche-balanced proposal source and local competition define a quality-diversity optimization paradigm, not a different mutation probability or population size. It differs from COWBOYS and SeqFlow BO by fitting no surrogate or optimizing a latent acquisition; from MolMIM CMA-ES and Molecule Swarm Optimization by maintaining no continuous latent distribution or particles; from Augmented Hill-Climb and the molecular GFlowNet by updating neither a token policy nor a trajectory-balance flow; from ChemTS by maintaining no prefix tree or UCT rollouts; from GenMol by using no fragment remasking or diffusion; and from annealed fragment-edit sampling by using no persistent Markov chains or Metropolis-Hastings acceptance. method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization because both adapt a corpus-initialized generator using returned rewards. The other close bound lineage is the replay-trained molecular GFlowNet, but that method enforces trajectory balance with forward and backward flows, a partition function, and positive terminal flow rewards so terminal sampling is reward-proportional; this method maximizes entropy-regularized expected return through learned soft Q-values and has neither a backward policy nor a flow-consistency loss. It also has no graph crossover or MAP-Elites archive, no UCT prefix tree, no reverse diffusion or fragment remasking, no Metropolis-Hastings accept/reject chain, and no continuous latent search, Gaussian process, CMA distribution, or particle velocities. method_proposal.method_thesis: Decompose the allowed unlabeled corpus into a fixed vocabulary of chemically sanitized, attachment-labelled fragments and use its reconstruction trajectories only to behavior-clone a task-agnostic graph policy. In each independent objective session, start complete constructions from a sampled vocabulary fragment and repeatedly sample a three-part categorical action: an open attachment site on the current partial graph, a fragment, and a compatible attachment site on that fragment, with an explicit stop action and valence-checked transitions. Canonicalize completed graphs and submit only fresh valid unique assemblies in the evaluator-announced batch; the vocabulary is a combinatorial action alphabet, not a pool of whole-molecule candidates. Put the scored initial molecules when representable and every subsequently generated trajectory into a task-local replay buffer, assign the observed oracle score only at the terminal transition, and update corrected twin soft-Q critics, the stochastic actor, and its entropy temperature from uniformly replayed transitions. The next molecules are sampled directly from the updated actor, so no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or screened and no finite molecular candidate set is enumerated. Off-policy trajectory reuse lets each scarce terminal observation train many partial-graph decisions, while maximum-entropy action sampling resists early policy collapse; both serve the sole benchmark target of a stronger final Top-1 on each session.

method_proposal.differentiation: The nearest bound lineage is Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization because both adapt a corpus-pretrained SMILES agent with top-fraction oracle feedback. Augmented Hill-Climb submits direct ancestral samples from the updated agent; this lineage periodically interrogates that agent by exhaustive high-probability partial-sequence expansion, extracts recurrent molecular motifs, and changes the actual proposal distribution into a dynamic motif-conditioned rejection sampler. That structural self-conditioning is a different proposal mechanism, not a learning-rate, backbone, reward scale, or sampling-temperature variation. It also differs from the bound ChemTS lineage: Beam Enumeration does not maintain a persistent reward-valued prefix tree, choose branches by UCT, score partial paths, or backpropagate rollout rewards; its beam is a temporary readout of the changing policy and every oracle proposal is a separately sampled complete molecule. Unlike GenMol it performs no SAFE fragment remasking or reverse diffusion, and unlike FREED++ or the molecular GFlowNet it performs neither fragment-action graph assembly nor trajectory-balance learning. The graph GA, MAP-Elites, and annealed MCMC lineages edit or recombine evaluated graphs; COWBOYS and SeqFlow use surrogate-directed latent proposals; CMA-ES and particle swarm evolve continuous latent states. This method uses none of those proposal mechanisms. The supplied Mechanism Cluster map is empty, so no campaign cluster refutes beam-derived structural self-conditioning. Importantly, enumerating partial token trajectories solely to derive a motif gate is not corpus-pool ranking, virtual screening, retrieval of whole molecules, or enumeration of a fixed molecular candidate set.
method_proposal.first_improvement_direction: Once the no-replay root succeeds, keep its prior, top-fraction policy loss, Beam Enumeration trigger and motif-gated de novo proposal mechanism fixed, and add exactly one Augmented Memory-style data-augmented experience-replay mechanism: retain a bounded task-local buffer of the best unique oracle-evaluated molecules, generate several randomized SMILES traversals of those same graphs, and replay their prior/agent likelihood targets with their already observed rewards during later updates without additional oracle calls. Guo and Schwaller report that experience replay with SMILES augmentation improves the sample efficiency of language-based de novo design, and the Beam Enumeration paper reports that its structural self-conditioning further improves Augmented Memory under a fixed oracle budget. Their experiments use larger budgets than this campaign, so the transfer claim is conditional: repeated graph-equivalent trajectories may let each scarce reward more reliably shape token probabilities and hence the motifs recovered by the beam, increasing the chance of a stronger terminal Top-1; replay counts and motif persistence are activation evidence only, never substitute objectives.

method_proposal.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, freeze a copy as the prior, and restart a trainable agent for each independent objective session. Generate the first proposals ancestrally, then use returned oracle scores to apply top-fraction prior-regularized likelihood updates to the agent. Whenever the recent reward trajectory shows sustained improvement, run Beam Enumeration on the current agent without calling the oracle: expand its most probable partial token trajectories, convert chemically interpretable partial strings into connected molecular substructures, and retain a small task-local pool of recurrent motifs. Fill subsequent evaluator-announced batches by sampling complete SMILES de novo from the agent and locally rejecting any valid novel sample that lacks every pooled motif; canonicalize and remove already evaluated or within-batch duplicates before submission. The enumerated objects are transient partial token trajectories, not whole candidate molecules, and neither they nor any corpus molecule are scored, ranked, retrieved, or submitted as a finite library. Thus oracle feedback changes both the policy and a dynamic structural gate on fresh generation, concentrating the 290 adaptive calls on chemistry expressed by successful policy updates while the only success criterion remains the mean of the five independent final Top-1 scores.

method_proposal.method_thesis: Extract a task-agnostic action alphabet of sanitized, attachment-labelled fragments and compatible attachment statistics from the allowed unlabeled corpus, retaining no whole corpus molecule as a candidate. In each independent objective session, initialize a fresh Ant System pheromone table over start-fragment, attachment-transition, and stop decisions, and seed it with deterministic fragment traces of the ten fixed scored starting molecules. For every evaluator-announced batch, independent ants begin from an empty graph and repeatedly sample valence-compatible construction actions with probability proportional to task-local pheromone times the fixed corpus-frequency heuristic, producing variable-length molecular graphs that are canonicalized and locally resampled until the returned batch is novel, valid, and unique. After oracle feedback, evaporate the global trail table and let every accepted construction deposit rank-weighted pheromone on exactly the components it used. This score-driven stigmergic memory recombines useful fragment transitions into fresh molecules without fitting a surrogate, retrieving or ranking a finite molecular pool, or enumerating a fixed candidate set. Trail statistics are mechanism evidence only; success is the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

method_proposal.method_thesis: Infer a valence-preserving molecular hypergraph-replacement grammar and context-conditioned production-rule prior from the allowed unlabeled corpus, retaining only reusable rules and counts rather than whole corpus molecules. In each independently restarted objective session, parse the ten fixed scored molecules into grammar derivations and initialize a task-local categorical rule distribution from the corpus prior. Generate every subsequent proposal de novo by ancestrally sampling a complete derivation from the start symbol, applying its productions to obtain a molecular graph, and locally resampling after invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate outcomes until the evaluator-announced batch is full. After each oracle response, select the highest-ranked evaluated derivations and perform the defining cross-entropy update: maximum-likelihood refit the context-conditioned rule probabilities to that elite set, with fixed smoothing toward the preceding distribution. Fit a probabilistic surrogate only to the ten fixed scored molecules and subsequent oracle-evaluated molecules, while maintaining an oracle-anchor policy updated only from returned true scores. Before each evaluator-announced batch, clone that anchor into a disposable inner policy, optimize the clone without oracle calls using the surrogate posterior mean as its molecular reward, and ancestrally sample a fresh ephemeral set of complete SMILES from the resulting policy. Canonicalize locally, remove invalid, previously evaluated, and duplicate molecules, and select the requested number by greedy batch expected improvement; after feedback, refit the surrogate, update the oracle anchor from the real observations, and discard the inner clone. Thus every submitted molecule is generated de novo, the corpus is never scored or searched as a candidate pool, and surrogate feedback changes the source distribution itself before acquisition rather than merely ranking proposals from a fixed generator. L16.method_thesis: A corpus-only canonical-SMILES language model supplies both a frozen generative prior and a frozen sequence embedding; each objective then fits an exact probabilistic surrogate to all real task-local observations, updates a persistent anchor only with true rewards, trains a disposable anchor clone only with surrogate posterior-mean rewards, ancestrally generates a fresh ephemeral pool from that shifted clone, and selects the announced batch by sequential expected improvement. The acyclic graph is one time-unrolled online transition: selected molecules are scored by the external evaluator, and that observe message re-enters the surrogate and true-anchor Layers on the next transition until the fixed budget ends.

nodes.method_thesis: Learn a task-agnostic forward and backward molecular-construction policy from the allowed unlabeled corpus using an atom-and-fragment graph grammar, then restart that policy independently for each objective. From an empty graph, the forward policy samples chemically valid attachment, bond, and stop actions until it produces a terminal molecule; whole corpus molecules are never retrieved, ranked, or used as a finite candidate pool. After each evaluator-announced batch is scored, map each observed score to a strictly positive tempered terminal reward and train on only oracle-evaluated molecules and their sampled construction/deconstruction trajectories using the trajectory-balance loss, a learned partition function, and reward-prioritized replay. Because trajectory balance assigns terminal probability according to total flow across every construction route rather than merely increasing the likelihood of one elite sequence, online feedback amortizes search into a de novo sampler whose probability mass concentrates on high-reward molecular regions while continuing to expose distinct routes to rare high-scoring structures. The optimization target remains the mean final Top-1 across the five independent sessions; flow statistics and replay usage are mechanism evidence, not substitute objectives.

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive normalizing flow on corpus-only SELFIES so that each discrete molecule has a continuous token-latent encoding whose left-inverse reconstructs that same sequence. In each fresh objective session, encode the oracle-evaluated molecules, fit a task-local Gaussian-process surrogate to their latent codes and observed scores, and center local trust regions on high-scoring evaluated anchors. Generate a new ephemeral candidate pool each round by uniformly choosing latent-token blocks to perturb inside those regions, inverse-decode the perturbed points, and locally reject invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate molecules before using posterior Thompson samples to choose the announced batch. Returned scores update the surrogate, anchors, and trust-region state. The corpus supplies only representation learning: no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or treated as a fixed candidate, and every oracle proposal is a newly decoded de novo molecule selected to raise terminal Top-1.

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, freeze a copy as the prior, and restart a trainable agent for each independent objective session. Generate the first proposals ancestrally, then use returned oracle scores to apply top-fraction prior-regularized likelihood updates to the agent. Whenever the recent reward trajectory shows sustained improvement, run Beam Enumeration on the current agent without calling the oracle: expand its most probable partial token trajectories, convert chemically interpretable partial strings into connected molecular substructures, and retain a small task-local pool of recurrent motifs. Fill subsequent evaluator-announced batches by sampling complete SMILES de novo from the agent and locally rejecting any valid novel sample that lacks every pooled motif; canonicalize and remove already evaluated or within-batch duplicates before submission. The enumerated objects are transient partial token trajectories, not whole candidate molecules, and neither they nor any corpus molecule are scored, ranked, retrieved, or submitted as a finite library. Thus oracle feedback changes both the policy and a dynamic structural gate on fresh generation, concentrating the 290 adaptive calls on chemistry expressed by successful policy updates while the only success criterion remains the mean of the five independent final Top-1 scores.

nodes.method_name: Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization
nodes.method_thesis: Pretrain an autoregressive SMILES language model on the allowed unlabeled corpus and freeze a copy as the molecular prior. During each objective session, sample complete molecules de novo token by token from a trainable agent, rank the accepted molecules by their observed oracle rewards, and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction using the Augmented Hill-Climb loss: the squared gap between agent log-likelihood and a target formed from prior log-likelihood plus scaled reward. Excluding low-reward samples from policy updates prevents them from repeatedly pulling the agent back toward the prior, while prior likelihood still regularizes the elite updates; this concentrates the scarce feedback on sequences associated with improvement of final Top-1 without screening a finite molecular pool.

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic sequence-to-sequence molecular autoencoder on randomized and canonicalized SMILES views of the allowed unlabeled corpus, then freeze its encoder and decoder. At the start of each independent objective session, encode the ten fixed scored initial molecules as ten persistent particles with latent velocities and personal-best memories. After every oracle response, update the personal and swarm-best memories, move each particle by the Molecular Swarm Optimization rule combining inertia with stochastic attraction toward its own best and the swarm's current and historical best positions, and decode one fresh valid unique molecule from each resulting trajectory for the next announced batch. Oracle scores therefore steer interacting de novo latent trajectories directly, without fitting a surrogate or selecting from the corpus, and the 290 adaptive calls are concentrated on finding an exceptional terminal molecule for final Top-1.

nodes.method_name: Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization
nodes.method_thesis: Pretrain an autoregressive SMILES language model on the allowed unlabeled corpus and freeze a copy as the molecular prior. During each objective session, sample complete molecules de novo token by token from a trainable agent, rank the accepted molecules by their observed oracle rewards, and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction using the Augmented Hill-Climb loss: the squared gap between agent log-likelihood and a target formed from prior log-likelihood plus scaled reward. Excluding low-reward samples from policy updates prevents them from repeatedly pulling the agent back toward the prior, while prior likelihood still regularizes the elite updates; this concentrates the scarce feedback on sequences associated with improvement of final Top-1 without screening a finite molecular pool.

nodes.method_thesis: Extract a task-agnostic action alphabet of sanitized, attachment-labelled fragments and compatible attachment statistics from the allowed unlabeled corpus, retaining no whole corpus molecule as a candidate. In each independent objective session, initialize a fresh Ant System pheromone table over start-fragment, attachment-transition, and stop decisions, and seed it with deterministic fragment traces of the ten fixed scored starting molecules. For every evaluator-announced batch, independent ants begin from an empty graph and repeatedly sample valence-compatible construction actions with probability proportional to task-local pheromone times the fixed corpus-frequency heuristic, producing variable-length molecular graphs that are canonicalized and locally resampled until the returned batch is novel, valid, and unique. After oracle feedback, evaporate the global trail table and let every accepted construction deposit rank-weighted pheromone on exactly the components it used. This score-driven stigmergic memory recombines useful fragment transitions into fresh molecules without fitting a surrogate, retrieving or ranking a finite molecular pool, or enumerating a fixed candidate set. Trail statistics are mechanism evidence only; success is the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

nodes.method_name: Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization
nodes.method_thesis: Pretrain an autoregressive SMILES language model on the allowed unlabeled corpus and freeze a copy as the molecular prior. During each objective session, sample complete molecules de novo token by token from a trainable agent, rank the accepted molecules by their observed oracle rewards, and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction using the Augmented Hill-Climb loss: the squared gap between agent log-likelihood and a target formed from prior log-likelihood plus scaled reward. Excluding low-reward samples from policy updates prevents them from repeatedly pulling the agent back toward the prior, while prior likelihood still regularizes the elite updates; this concentrates the scarce feedback on sequences associated with improvement of final Top-1 without screening a finite molecular pool.

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, freeze a copy as the prior, and restart a trainable agent for each independent objective session. Generate the first proposals ancestrally, then use returned oracle scores to apply top-fraction prior-regularized likelihood updates to the agent. Whenever the recent reward trajectory shows sustained improvement, run Beam Enumeration on the current agent without calling the oracle: expand its most probable partial token trajectories, convert chemically interpretable partial strings into connected molecular substructures, and retain a small task-local pool of recurrent motifs. Fill subsequent evaluator-announced batches by sampling complete SMILES de novo from the agent and locally rejecting any valid novel sample that lacks every pooled motif; canonicalize and remove already evaluated or within-batch duplicates before submission. The enumerated objects are transient partial token trajectories, not whole candidate molecules, and neither they nor any corpus molecule are scored, ranked, retrieved, or submitted as a finite library. Thus oracle feedback changes both the policy and a dynamic structural gate on fresh generation, concentrating the 290 adaptive calls on chemistry expressed by successful policy updates while the only success criterion remains the mean of the five independent final Top-1 scores.

nodes.method_thesis: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model and its sequence representation only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, retain a frozen prior, and restart all task-local state for each independent objective. Fit a probabilistic surrogate only to the ten fixed scored molecules and subsequent oracle-evaluated molecules, while maintaining an oracle-anchor policy updated only from returned true scores. Before each evaluator-announced batch, clone that anchor into a disposable inner policy, optimize the clone without oracle calls using the surrogate posterior mean as its molecular reward, and ancestrally sample a fresh ephemeral set of complete SMILES from the resulting policy. Canonicalize locally, remove invalid, previously evaluated, and duplicate molecules, and select the requested number by greedy batch expected improvement; after feedback, refit the surrogate, update the oracle anchor from the real observations, and discard the inner clone. Thus every submitted molecule is generated de novo, the corpus is never scored or searched as a candidate pool, and surrogate feedback changes the source distribution itself before acquisition rather than merely ranking proposals from a fixed generator. The optimization target is solely the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive normalizing flow on corpus-only SELFIES so that each discrete molecule has a continuous token-latent encoding whose left-inverse reconstructs that same sequence. In each fresh objective session, encode the oracle-evaluated molecules, fit a task-local Gaussian-process surrogate to their latent codes and observed scores, and center local trust regions on high-scoring evaluated anchors. Generate a new ephemeral candidate pool each round by uniformly choosing latent-token blocks to perturb inside those regions, inverse-decode the perturbed points, and locally reject invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate molecules before using posterior Thompson samples to choose the announced batch. Returned scores update the surrogate, anchors, and trust-region state. The corpus supplies only representation learning: no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or treated as a fixed candidate, and every oracle proposal is a newly decoded de novo molecule selected to raise terminal Top-1.

nodes.method_name: Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization
nodes.method_thesis: Pretrain an autoregressive SMILES language model on the allowed unlabeled corpus and freeze a copy as the molecular prior. During each objective session, sample complete molecules de novo token by token from a trainable agent, rank the accepted molecules by their observed oracle rewards, and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction using the Augmented Hill-Climb loss: the squared gap between agent log-likelihood and a target formed from prior log-likelihood plus scaled reward. Excluding low-reward samples from policy updates prevents them from repeatedly pulling the agent back toward the prior, while prior likelihood still regularizes the elite updates; this concentrates the scarce feedback on sequences associated with improvement of final Top-1 without screening a finite molecular pool.

nodes.method_thesis: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model and its sequence representation only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, retain a frozen prior, and restart all task-local state for each independent objective. Fit a probabilistic surrogate only to the ten fixed scored molecules and subsequent oracle-evaluated molecules, while maintaining an oracle-anchor policy updated only from returned true scores. Before each evaluator-announced batch, clone that anchor into a disposable inner policy, optimize the clone without oracle calls using the surrogate posterior mean as its molecular reward, and ancestrally sample a fresh ephemeral set of complete SMILES from the resulting policy. Canonicalize locally, remove invalid, previously evaluated, and duplicate molecules, and select the requested number by greedy batch expected improvement; after feedback, refit the surrogate, update the oracle anchor from the real observations, and discard the inner clone. Thus every submitted molecule is generated de novo, the corpus is never scored or searched as a candidate pool, and surrogate feedback changes the source distribution itself before acquisition rather than merely ranking proposals from a fixed generator. The optimization target is solely the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic MolMIM-style probabilistic SMILES autoencoder only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, using variance-conditioned latent training so local perturbations remain decodable, and then freeze it. In each independent objective session, encode the fixed evaluated starting molecules, center a CMA-ES search distribution on the best observed latent, and repeat an ask/tell loop: sample a fresh latent population from the current multivariate Gaussian, decode each point de novo, canonicalize and locally replace invalid or previously seen molecules, submit only the newly decoded batch, and update the Gaussian mean, covariance, and global step size from the returned score ranks. The method neither fits a surrogate nor screens the corpus; oracle feedback changes the continuous proposal distribution directly, so coordinated latent directions that repeatedly yield better molecules receive more probability during the 290 adaptive calls. The sole success target is the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic bidirectional masked discrete-diffusion model on SAFE fragment sequences from the allowed unlabeled corpus, then keep its weights frozen during every objective session. Initialize a dynamic fragment vocabulary only from oracle-evaluated molecules, score each fragment by the observed rewards of molecules containing it, and construct each new starting context by sampling and attaching high-scoring fragments. Replace one complete fragment span with mask tokens and iteratively denoise that span in parallel while conditioning on the retained fragments; canonicalize locally and submit only newly generated valid unique molecules. Oracle feedback updates fragment scores and admits fragments from evaluated offspring, so the generator can repeatedly refine promising chemistry while its learned conditional denoising can synthesize fragments outside the current vocabulary. Every candidate is therefore generated de novo rather than retrieved or ranked from the corpus, and reward-directed fragment regeneration targets improvement of the final Top-1 within the sparse feedback budget.

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, freeze a copy as the prior, and restart a trainable agent for each independent objective session. Generate the first proposals ancestrally, then use returned oracle scores to apply top-fraction prior-regularized likelihood updates to the agent. Whenever the recent reward trajectory shows sustained improvement, run Beam Enumeration on the current agent without calling the oracle: expand its most probable partial token trajectories, convert chemically interpretable partial strings into connected molecular substructures, and retain a small task-local pool of recurrent motifs. Fill subsequent evaluator-announced batches by sampling complete SMILES de novo from the agent and locally rejecting any valid novel sample that lacks every pooled motif; canonicalize and remove already evaluated or within-batch duplicates before submission. The enumerated objects are transient partial token trajectories, not whole candidate molecules, and neither they nor any corpus molecule are scored, ranked, retrieved, or submitted as a finite library. Thus oracle feedback changes both the policy and a dynamic structural gate on fresh generation, concentrating the 290 adaptive calls on chemistry expressed by successful policy updates while the only success criterion remains the mean of the five independent final Top-1 scores.

nodes.method_thesis: Infer a valence-preserving molecular hypergraph-replacement grammar and context-conditioned production-rule prior from the allowed unlabeled corpus, retaining only reusable rules and counts rather than whole corpus molecules. In each independently restarted objective session, parse the ten fixed scored molecules into grammar derivations and initialize a task-local categorical rule distribution from the corpus prior. Generate every subsequent proposal de novo by ancestrally sampling a complete derivation from the start symbol, applying its productions to obtain a molecular graph, and locally resampling after invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate outcomes until the evaluator-announced batch is full. After each oracle response, select the highest-ranked evaluated derivations and perform the defining cross-entropy update: maximum-likelihood refit the context-conditioned rule probabilities to that elite set, with fixed smoothing toward the preceding distribution. Thus feedback moves probability mass toward production combinations occurring in the best complete molecules without crossover, mutation, a surrogate, a value function, or a finite candidate library; the sole optimization target is a stronger terminal Top-1 in each of the five independent sessions and hence their equal-weight mean.

nodes.method_thesis: Extract a vocabulary of single-attachment fragments from the allowed unlabeled corpus without scoring or retrieving any whole corpus molecule, and start one persistent molecular-graph Markov chain from each of the ten fixed evaluated molecules. In every feedback round, generate one fresh candidate per chain through a locally sanitized, reversible fragment-add or fragment-delete transition, retrying locally until the batch contains ten novel canonical molecules. After the oracle returns, accept each proposed state with a Metropolis-Hastings probability for an annealed score density, including its forward/reverse proposal ratio; rejected proposals leave their chains at the previous states. Low inverse temperature initially permits controlled downhill moves that can cross structural valleys, while increasing concentration later favors high-score states. Thus all oracle calls evaluate de novo molecular constructions, and feedback directly steers persistent search paths toward a stronger final Top-1 without a surrogate, a learned generator, or finite-library screening.

nodes.method_name: Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization
nodes.method_thesis: Pretrain an autoregressive SMILES language model on the allowed unlabeled corpus and freeze a copy as the molecular prior. During each objective session, sample complete molecules de novo token by token from a trainable agent, rank the accepted molecules by their observed oracle rewards, and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction using the Augmented Hill-Climb loss: the squared gap between agent log-likelihood and a target formed from prior log-likelihood plus scaled reward. Excluding low-reward samples from policy updates prevents them from repeatedly pulling the agent back toward the prior, while prior likelihood still regularizes the elite updates; this concentrates the scarce feedback on sequences associated with improvement of final Top-1 without screening a finite molecular pool.

nodes.method_thesis: Decompose the allowed unlabeled corpus into a fixed vocabulary of chemically sanitized, attachment-labelled fragments and use its reconstruction trajectories only to behavior-clone a task-agnostic graph policy. In each independent objective session, start complete constructions from a sampled vocabulary fragment and repeatedly sample a three-part categorical action: an open attachment site on the current partial graph, a fragment, and a compatible attachment site on that fragment, with an explicit stop action and valence-checked transitions. Canonicalize completed graphs and submit only fresh valid unique assemblies in the evaluator-announced batch; the vocabulary is a combinatorial action alphabet, not a pool of whole-molecule candidates. Put the scored initial molecules when representable and every subsequently generated trajectory into a task-local replay buffer, assign the observed oracle score only at the terminal transition, and update corrected twin soft-Q critics, the stochastic actor, and its entropy temperature from uniformly replayed transitions. The next molecules are sampled directly from the updated actor, so no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or screened and no finite molecular candidate set is enumerated. Off-policy trajectory reuse lets each scarce terminal observation train many partial-graph decisions, while maximum-entropy action sampling resists early policy collapse; both serve the sole benchmark target of a stronger final Top-1 on each session.

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic SELFIES variational autoencoder on the unlabeled corpus solely as a de novo molecular generator, while fitting the online objective surrogate only on oracle-evaluated molecules using count-based molecular fingerprints and a Tanimoto Gaussian process. At each feedback round, use preconditioned Crank-Nicolson sampling to draw new latent points from the VAE prior tilted by the GP posterior probability of exceeding the incumbent, decode them into previously unseen molecules, and greedily choose a high-utility batch of ten. Decoupling generation from structure-space prediction avoids requiring objective smoothness in the VAE latent geometry and directs the fixed 290 post-initial oracle calls toward molecules likely to improve the final Top-1 rather than screening or retrieving a finite corpus pool.

nodes.method_name: ChemTS-style RNN-guided Monte Carlo tree search
nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic recurrent next-token model on the allowed unlabeled SMILES corpus and freeze it as a chemical-language prior. For each independent objective session, grow a fresh Monte Carlo search tree whose nodes are SMILES prefixes: initialize available path statistics from the ten scored starting molecules, select prefixes by an upper-confidence tree rule, expand them with high-probability unseen tokens from the frozen model, and use model rollouts to complete new molecules. Canonicalize locally and submit batches containing only newly constructed, valid, unique terminal SMILES; after each oracle response, backpropagate the observed scores through the visited prefix paths. The dynamically expanded tree therefore converts 290 feedback calls into increasingly focused de novo construction toward high terminal rewards without updating a policy, fitting a latent surrogate, mutating evaluated parent graphs, or ranking a finite corpus pool.

nodes.method_thesis: For each independent objective session, place only the ten fixed oracle-evaluated starting molecules into a fresh MAP-Elites archive whose cells are a small fixed centroidal Voronoi tessellation of task-agnostic RDKit physicochemical descriptors. Draw occupied cells rather than globally ranked molecules, use their evaluated elites as parents for sanitized molecular-graph crossover and positional analogue mutation, and submit only novel valid offspring constructed de novo. After oracle feedback, map each accepted offspring to its descriptor cell and replace that cell's occupant only when the returned score is higher. Cell-local competition preserves structurally different stepping stones that a single global elite population would discard, while every cell still optimizes the same task reward and the global incumbent across the archive remains the sole terminal Top-1 target. The unlabeled corpus may define descriptor ranges or mutation fragments but is never scored, retrieved, ranked, or treated as a candidate pool; archive coverage and diversity are mechanism evidence rather than benchmark objectives.

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, freeze a copy as the prior, and restart a trainable agent for each independent objective session. Generate the first proposals ancestrally, then use returned oracle scores to apply top-fraction prior-regularized likelihood updates to the agent. Whenever the recent reward trajectory shows sustained improvement, run Beam Enumeration on the current agent without calling the oracle: expand its most probable partial token trajectories, convert chemically interpretable partial strings into connected molecular substructures, and retain a small task-local pool of recurrent motifs. Fill subsequent evaluator-announced batches by sampling complete SMILES de novo from the agent and locally rejecting any valid novel sample that lacks every pooled motif; canonicalize and remove already evaluated or within-batch duplicates before submission. The enumerated objects are transient partial token trajectories, not whole candidate molecules, and neither they nor any corpus molecule are scored, ranked, retrieved, or submitted as a finite library. Thus oracle feedback changes both the policy and a dynamic structural gate on fresh generation, concentrating the 290 adaptive calls on chemistry expressed by successful policy updates while the only success criterion remains the mean of the five independent final Top-1 scores.

nodes.method_thesis: For each independent objective session, place only the ten fixed oracle-evaluated starting molecules into a fresh MAP-Elites archive whose cells are a small fixed centroidal Voronoi tessellation of task-agnostic RDKit physicochemical descriptors. Draw occupied cells rather than globally ranked molecules, use their evaluated elites as parents for sanitized molecular-graph crossover and positional analogue mutation, and submit only novel valid offspring constructed de novo. After oracle feedback, map each accepted offspring to its descriptor cell and replace that cell's occupant only when the returned score is higher. Cell-local competition preserves structurally different stepping stones that a single global elite population would discard, while every cell still optimizes the same task reward and the global incumbent across the archive remains the sole terminal Top-1 target. The unlabeled corpus may define descriptor ranges or mutation fragments but is never scored, retrieved, ranked, or treated as a candidate pool; archive coverage and diversity are mechanism evidence rather than benchmark objectives.

nodes.method_thesis: Decompose the allowed unlabeled corpus into a fixed vocabulary of chemically sanitized, attachment-labelled fragments and use its reconstruction trajectories only to behavior-clone a task-agnostic graph policy. In each independent objective session, start complete constructions from a sampled vocabulary fragment and repeatedly sample a three-part categorical action: an open attachment site on the current partial graph, a fragment, and a compatible attachment site on that fragment, with an explicit stop action and valence-checked transitions. Canonicalize completed graphs and submit only fresh valid unique assemblies in the evaluator-announced batch; the vocabulary is a combinatorial action alphabet, not a pool of whole-molecule candidates. Put the scored initial molecules when representable and every subsequently generated trajectory into a task-local replay buffer, assign the observed oracle score only at the terminal transition, and update corrected twin soft-Q critics, the stochastic actor, and its entropy temperature from uniformly replayed transitions. The next molecules are sampled directly from the updated actor, so no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or screened and no finite molecular candidate set is enumerated. Off-policy trajectory reuse lets each scarce terminal observation train many partial-graph decisions, while maximum-entropy action sampling resists early policy collapse; both serve the sole benchmark target of a stronger final Top-1 on each session.

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic recurrent next-token model on the allowed unlabeled SMILES corpus and freeze it as a chemical-language prior. For each independent objective session, grow a fresh Monte Carlo search tree whose nodes are SMILES prefixes: initialize available path statistics from the ten scored starting molecules, select prefixes by an upper-confidence tree rule, expand them with high-probability unseen tokens from the frozen model, and use model rollouts to complete new molecules. Canonicalize locally and submit batches containing only newly constructed, valid, unique terminal SMILES; after each oracle response, backpropagate the observed scores through the visited prefix paths. The dynamically expanded tree therefore converts 290 feedback calls into increasingly focused de novo construction toward high terminal rewards without updating a policy, fitting a latent surrogate, mutating evaluated parent graphs, or ranking a finite corpus pool.

method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline next-token model training plus online backpropagation of observed rewards into prefix visit counts and values
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: upper-confidence prefix selection, prior-guided token expansion, and recurrent rollouts to de novo terminal SMILES
method_tags.representation: tokenized SMILES prefixes with a frozen recurrent chemical-language prior

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive normalizing flow on corpus-only SELFIES so that each discrete molecule has a continuous token-latent encoding whose left-inverse reconstructs that same sequence. In each fresh objective session, encode the oracle-evaluated molecules, fit a task-local Gaussian-process surrogate to their latent codes and observed scores, and center local trust regions on high-scoring evaluated anchors. Generate a new ephemeral candidate pool each round by uniformly choosing latent-token blocks to perturb inside those regions, inverse-decode the perturbed points, and locally reject invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate molecules before using posterior Thompson samples to choose the announced batch. Returned scores update the surrogate, anchors, and trust-region state. The corpus supplies only representation learning: no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or treated as a fixed candidate, and every oracle proposal is a newly decoded de novo molecule selected to raise terminal Top-1.

nodes.method_name: Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization
nodes.method_thesis: Pretrain an autoregressive SMILES language model on the allowed unlabeled corpus and freeze a copy as the molecular prior. During each objective session, sample complete molecules de novo token by token from a trainable agent, rank the accepted molecules by their observed oracle rewards, and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction using the Augmented Hill-Climb loss: the squared gap between agent log-likelihood and a target formed from prior log-likelihood plus scaled reward. Excluding low-reward samples from policy updates prevents them from repeatedly pulling the agent back toward the prior, while prior likelihood still regularizes the elite updates; this concentrates the scarce feedback on sequences associated with improvement of final Top-1 without screening a finite molecular pool.

nodes.method_thesis: Extract a vocabulary of single-attachment fragments from the allowed unlabeled corpus without scoring or retrieving any whole corpus molecule, and start one persistent molecular-graph Markov chain from each of the ten fixed evaluated molecules. In every feedback round, generate one fresh candidate per chain through a locally sanitized, reversible fragment-add or fragment-delete transition, retrying locally until the batch contains ten novel canonical molecules. After the oracle returns, accept each proposed state with a Metropolis-Hastings probability for an annealed score density, including its forward/reverse proposal ratio; rejected proposals leave their chains at the previous states. Low inverse temperature initially permits controlled downhill moves that can cross structural valleys, while increasing concentration later favors high-score states. Thus all oracle calls evaluate de novo molecular constructions, and feedback directly steers persistent search paths toward a stronger final Top-1 without a surrogate, a learned generator, or finite-library screening.

nodes.method_thesis: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model and its sequence representation only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, retain a frozen prior, and restart all task-local state for each independent objective. Fit a probabilistic surrogate only to the ten fixed scored molecules and subsequent oracle-evaluated molecules, while maintaining an oracle-anchor policy updated only from returned true scores. Before each evaluator-announced batch, clone that anchor into a disposable inner policy, optimize the clone without oracle calls using the surrogate posterior mean as its molecular reward, and ancestrally sample a fresh ephemeral set of complete SMILES from the resulting policy. Canonicalize locally, remove invalid, previously evaluated, and duplicate molecules, and select the requested number by greedy batch expected improvement; after feedback, refit the surrogate, update the oracle anchor from the real observations, and discard the inner clone. Thus every submitted molecule is generated de novo, the corpus is never scored or searched as a candidate pool, and surrogate feedback changes the source distribution itself before acquisition rather than merely ranking proposals from a fixed generator. The optimization target is solely the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, freeze a copy as the prior, and restart a trainable agent for each independent objective session. Generate the first proposals ancestrally, then use returned oracle scores to apply top-fraction prior-regularized likelihood updates to the agent. Whenever the recent reward trajectory shows sustained improvement, run Beam Enumeration on the current agent without calling the oracle: expand its most probable partial token trajectories, convert chemically interpretable partial strings into connected molecular substructures, and retain a small task-local pool of recurrent motifs. Fill subsequent evaluator-announced batches by sampling complete SMILES de novo from the agent and locally rejecting any valid novel sample that lacks every pooled motif; canonicalize and remove already evaluated or within-batch duplicates before submission. The enumerated objects are transient partial token trajectories, not whole candidate molecules, and neither they nor any corpus molecule are scored, ranked, retrieved, or submitted as a finite library. Thus oracle feedback changes both the policy and a dynamic structural gate on fresh generation, concentrating the 290 adaptive calls on chemistry expressed by successful policy updates while the only success criterion remains the mean of the five independent final Top-1 scores.

nodes.method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive normalizing flow on corpus-only SELFIES so that each discrete molecule has a continuous token-latent encoding whose left-inverse reconstructs that same sequence. In each fresh objective session, encode the oracle-evaluated molecules, fit a task-local Gaussian-process surrogate to their latent codes and observed scores, and center local trust regions on high-scoring evaluated anchors. Generate a new ephemeral candidate pool each round by uniformly choosing latent-token blocks to perturb inside those regions, inverse-decode the perturbed points, and locally reject invalid, previously evaluated, or duplicate molecules before using posterior Thompson samples to choose the announced batch. Returned scores update the surrogate, anchors, and trust-region state. The corpus supplies only representation learning: no corpus molecule is retrieved, ranked, or treated as a fixed candidate, and every oracle proposal is a newly decoded de novo molecule selected to raise terminal Top-1.
